content.text: Study Abroad 2024 – Document Checklist & Attestation Guide for Indian Students

Studying abroad opens a world of opportunities — globally recognized education, international exposure, and better career prospects. But before you can board your flight, a crucial step awaits: proper documentation and legalization.
This blog gives you a full-proof checklist and a simple guide to apostille and attestation requirements for students planning to study abroad in 2024.
Why Legalizing Documents Is Mandatory for Studying Abroad
Foreign universities and visa authorities require Indian students to submit legally validated documents. This ensures your documents are:
Depending on the destination country, you will either need:

items: Apostille (for Hague Convention countries like France, Germany, Italy)
Embassy Attestation (for UAE, Qatar, China, etc.)
